effect: The supplied cell bodies and signalling fibres form nervous tissue, completing the chapter. The result distinguishes signals travelling along fibres from messengers crossing gaps.
reaction: It was satisfying to see the separate parts become connected tissue, though the supporting cells and fatty coverings appeared without much explanation.

mostWorthwhile.text: Preparing the signalling endings was most worthwhile: the three panels showed a signal reaching the end and messengers crossing the gap.

leastWorthwhile.text: Attaching the receiving branches was straightforward but less interesting than seeing how messages pass between cells.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the finished tissue included supporting cells and fatty fibre coverings that we hadn't assembled separately.

arbitrary.text: No action felt especially arbitrary: the pictures and goals gave each pairing a purpose. The included supporting cells and coverings were less clearly explained.

continue.text: I'd probably try another chapter to see how the nervous tissue connects to other body parts, although the last two choices here were automatic-feeling because each was the only combination offered.
